text.tspan: Response to reviews of manuscript #MS-XXXX "A representative
study on the mechanisms and implications of an example
scientific process"

svg.text: Author A, Author B, Author C, Author D

text.tspan: We greatly appreciate the Editor and reviewers for their insightful comments and
suggestions. We have carefully revised the manuscript and provide a point-by-point
response below.
(1) The central assumption used in the analysis provides a reasonable first-order
simplification. It would be helpful if the authors could briefly acknowledge
this assumption and clarify its limitations in the manuscript.
We thank the reviewer for this constructive suggestion. We agree that the
main assumption underlying the analysis should be
stated more explicitly. In the revised manuscript, we have clarified that
the simplified framework is used as a first-order approximation
and have added a short discussion of the associated limitations.
To implement the analysis, we used a simplified representation of the study
system as a first-order approximation. This treatment helps isolate the primary
mechanism examined here, but it does not capture all possible spatial or temporal
variability. We have therefore clarified this assumption and added a limitation
statement to avoid overinterpreting the model results.
(2) The connection between the results and previous observations could be
strengthened by adding a brief comparison with relevant published studies.
We appreciate this helpful suggestion. We have added a qualitative
comparison with previous observations and clarified the interpretation.
